question:
**Direction: The sentence given below has one misspelt word. Spot the INCORRECTLY spelt word and select its correct spelling.**

A trimphant smile appeared on his face.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Triumphant."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 

__
 
• The incorrectly spelt word is **"Trimphant."**
 
• 
 
The correct spelling is **"Triumphant."**

 
 
• 
 
"Triumphant" means feeling or showing great happiness because you have won or succeeded at something. (विजय या सफलता की प्राप्ति पर अत्‍यंत प्रसन्‍न; विजयोल्‍लसित)

 
 
• 
 
**Example**: *She made a **triumphant**__ return to the stage after several years of working in television.*

 
 
 
 
• 
 
​​Hence, option 2 is the correct answer.

 

**Correct sentence**: *A __**triumphant**__ smile appeared on his face. *
